approaches_tried.approach: Use the word-landmark-anchored gap span directly as the literal edit region for every occurrence
approaches_tried.reason: CRITICAL BUG: the gap only needs to CONTAIN corruption evidence for classification, it is not guaranteed to equal the corruption complex exactly; the first --write on both bacon_2018 and baier_katoen_2008 deleted real surrounding content (bacon_2018 lost 137 words across 16 fixes, baier_katoen part01 lost 84 words across 7 fixes). Caught via word-count sanity check immediately after the write; both files restored byte-for-byte from verified backups before any further action. Fixed by narrowing every edit to a precise sub-span, adding a per-edit span cap (>6 chars refused), and a whole-file word-count circuit breaker.
